_doc: Compute step settings (pipeline/facts.py). Lists are matched on WCL ability names. Decisions: docs/decisions.md.
_scripted_deaths: Deaths left out of the death stats (Fishbait, Floor Inspector, Spectator...). Fury of Frostmourne: the Lich King kills the whole raid. Divine Intervention: a paladin sacrificing himself on purpose, mostly at a wipe call (713 deaths, 178 on the Lich King).
_min_players: Pulls with fewer players holding a role are fake logs (e.g. a 1-player Onyxia) and are dropped. Raid splits stay.
_scaled_totals: Career totals (damage done, damage taken, healing done) ranked across expansions: each pull's amount is divided by the median rate of the reference players in that pull (median of the DPS for damage done, of the healers for healing; mean of the whole raid for damage taken, since in 40-man raids the median player takes next to nothing), giving seconds of a median raider, then multiplied by the guild's median rate on the kills of this tier (id in config/tiers.json). The actual total is shown next to it.
_excluded_encounters: WCL encounter IDs left out of every stat and record. Vehicle and cannon fights, where damage, healing and deaths do not reflect the players: 744 Flame Leviathan, 847 Icecrown Gunship Battle.
_min_score_peers: Performance scores (base 100 vs the median of the role in the pull): the median leaves out players at 0 and needs at least this many players of the role above 0, else the pull gets no score.
_cd_death_tolerance_ms: Blamed the Healer: a defensive cooldown removed up to this long before a tank's death still counts as up. WCL logs the removal of a dying player's buffs 100 to 400 ms before the death (500 ms: 62 deaths out of 2,065, 1 s: 71, 2 s: 81 in Era and TBC).
_cd_ignored_ids: Blamed the Healer: buffs left out of the defensive cooldowns although already in the crawl cache (taken out of config/crawl.json extras.defensive_cds after the crawl). 64205: Divine Sacrifice, a raid cooldown cast by a holy paladin, not the tank's own. 81256: Dancing Rune Weapon, mostly an offensive cooldown.
_tank_classes: Every expansion: a player WCL lists as a tank whose class cannot tank plays DPS (WCL class names).
_era_tank: Classic Era only: WCL lists as tanks only the Protection / Guardian talent builds, so tanks in a DPS build (Feral, fury-prot) are missed. A player of a tanking class is a tank when WCL lists him as one, or when he took at least this share of the boss melee damage of the pull, or of the adds melee damage (off-tanks). 25%: at 10%, fury warriors hit by a cleave or a tank swap counted as tanks. Players WCL lists as healers stay healers.
_wotlk_consumables: WotLK only: potionUse / healthstoneUse are almost always 0 (365 potions in 2,019 pulls), consumables are counted from a Casts table filtered on these ability IDs (crawl complement). Speed 53908, Wild Magic 53909, Runic Healing Potion 43185, Runic Mana Potion 43186, Indestructible 53762, Runic Healing / Mana Injector 67489 / 67490, Fel Healthstone 47875-47877. A cast whose name holds 'Healthstone' is a healthstone. TBC, Cata and MoP keep WCL's counters (TBC's include Haste and Destruction).
_era_consumables: Classic Era only: potionUse / healthstoneUse are always 0, consumables are counted from the Casts table. Mana potions cast 'Restore Mana', protection potions cast their effect.
_enchants: Enchantable slots (WCL gear slot numbers). Shoulders count in Classic Era from AQ40 only. Off hand counts only for a weapon or a shield (not a caster held-in-off-hand item), ranged only for hunters.

enchants._skip_by_expansion: Slots without any enchant in that expansion: MoP removed head enchants, and the hunter's weapon moved to the main hand.

_reset: Weekly reset of the Oceanic realms (US region): Tuesday 15:00 UTC. Reset weeks are counted from this anchor.
_timezone: Guild time zone: raid nights (best friend, late arrival, early leaver) and dates shown on the site.
_guild_time: Other guilds than Fable: their own weekly reset anchor and time zone (same keys as above). NightShift (Thunderstrike, EU): Wednesday 04:00 UTC.
_engineering_abilities: Engineer's Pride: damage done by these abilities (bombs, grenades, sappers, dynamite).
_single_target: The Terrorist, single target version: friendly fire of single target abilities only. aoe: abilities that hit several targets (cleaves, chains, AoE), left out; aoe_by_expansion: AoE in that expansion only (Arcane Barrage hits extra targets in MoP); every other ability (melee, Auto Shot included) is single target. first_hit_only: abilities whose first hit lands on one target and the next ones spread (Living Bomb's explosion, Killing Spree's jumps, item and mechanic effects): per source and ability, a run of hits with gaps under first_hit_gap_ms counts as single target on the first target hit only. Their events are crawled apart (crawl_extra ff_events); without them, they count as AoE. The source's damage on himself is left out, as in the full version: self_damage abilities whole, plus any other damage on himself.
_friendly_kills: Headhunter and Collateral Damage: deaths whose killing blow comes from another raid member, with one of his own abilities: an ability the guild's players dealt damage to enemies with on at least min_encounters different bosses (melee, Bladestorm, Chain Lightning...). Boss mechanics a player carries to his mates (Unstable Vita, Searing Seed, Deep Corruption: the large majority of player-sourced killing blows) are left out.
_arch_nemesis_ignore: Arch-Nemesis: killing blows left out (a quarter of all deaths are 'Melee', which names no boss or mechanic), and the players' own spells that land the last blow: Cauterize (the mage burns after a lethal hit), Shadow Word: Death (backlash), Blessing of Sacrifice and Divine Sacrifice (damage taken for someone else); Sacrifice (spell 140271, MoP: kills mostly two-handed warriors and death knights on every boss, at the end of wipes: an item effect, not a boss mechanic).
_heartbreak_pct: Heartbreaker: a wipe with the encounter (WCL fightPercentage) below this share of its health.
_obliterated: Obliterated: biggest overkill, as a multiple of the median overkill of the guild's deaths in the expansion. An ability is an instant kill mechanic, left out, when on a boss it has at least min_deaths deaths and its smallest overkill is above instakill_factor times that median (Ethereal Corruption, Rocket Strike, Ascend to the Heavens, Dark Glare, Hand of Death...).
_suicide_pact: Suicide Pact: two players dying within window_s of each other in a pull. Only the deaths before max_dead_share of the raid is down count, else every wipe would pair everyone.
_final_bosses: Final Boss Energy: last boss of each raid.
_night_gap_hours: Hours in raid: a report is split into raid nights at any gap between boss pulls longer than this.
_overachiever: Overachiever (DPS and healers, kills): score minus the mean score of other guild players of the same role and expansion whose item level, relative to their pull, is within this tolerance of his. Era item levels are packed tight, hence a narrower window.
